note: Derived, not typed. If the 40 MHz record changes, regenerate and the prediction changes with it -- which is why the generator is committed alongside the result.

predictions.basis: it never leaves the PL, so the model says its cycle count does not depend on the design clock. A reading outside the 40 MHz run's own spread falsifies either the model or the claim that this ROI stays in the fabric.
predictions.falsifies_if: the reading differs by more than the 40 MHz spread

bracket_meaning.low: every cycle of the excess is fixed time in the PS/DDR path, so at 25 MHz it costs 0.625 of the cycles it costs at 40 MHz
bracket_meaning.high: none of it is fixed time; the excess is design-clock work and the cycle count is unchanged

predictions.basis: the DRAM load's excess over the CLINT load is the part that leaves the fabric. The two ends of the bracket are the two pure hypotheses; the measurement falls between them and its position IS T_fixed.
predictions.falsifies_if: the reading falls outside the bracket by more than the two runs' spreads, which would mean the excess is neither fixed time nor design-clock work
